<p class="page-lede">My research combines causal inference and structural modelling to study transport regulation, electric mobility, market competition, energy efficiency, and social welfare.</p>

## Publication

::: {.paper .featured-paper}
<span class="paper-status">Published · 2025</span>

### Effectiveness and Efficiency of Incentivizing Policies for New Energy Vehicles: From the Perspective of Powertrain Type

Yuhan Liu, Yunyi Hu, and Xuemei Zheng. *Transportation Research Part A: Policy and Practice*, 199, 104530.

This paper combines fixed-effects evidence, nested-logit demand estimation, instrumental variables, and counterfactual welfare analysis to evaluate China's electric-vehicle incentives across powertrain types.

**Keywords:** electric vehicles; policy evaluation; structural demand; willingness to pay; counterfactual welfare

[View publication](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0965856425001582){.paper-link}
:::
